# WeCcelerate — 360° Wrap-Around Support from Idea to Successful Global Startup

> WeCcelerate (וויסלרייט) is Israel's leading Venture Builder and Startup Accelerator, headquartered in Tel Aviv (HaRakevet 58) with offices in Jerusalem. We provide 360° wrap-around support — helping early-stage startups access enterprise-grade resources so they can operate like a mature-stage startup from day one. Our strategic partnership with Leumit Health Services provides an exclusive Medical Accelerator track.

## Company Overview

- **Legal Name**: WeCcelerate Ltd.
- **Hebrew Name**: וויסלרייט
- **Founded**: 2020
- **Locations**: Tel Aviv (HaRakevet 58) & Jerusalem
- **Website**: https://weccelerate.co.il
- **Contact**: info@weccelerate.co.il | +972-55-564-7538
- **Languages**: Hebrew, English

## Services

### 1. Business Consulting & Strategy
Full business consulting for entrepreneurs: market research, competitive analysis, business plan development, financial modeling, executive summary, and marketing strategy. We help founders build investor-ready documents and go-to-market plans.
- URL: https://weccelerate.co.il/services/business-consulting

### 2. Physical Product Development
End-to-end engineering process from industrial design through prototyping (3D printing, CNC) to mass manufacturing. We manage the entire product lifecycle including supplier sourcing, quality assurance, and certification.
- URL: https://weccelerate.co.il/services/physical-product

### 3. Digital Product Development
Full-stack app and web development: UX/UI design, frontend and backend development, MVP builds, SaaS platforms, mobile apps (React Native, Flutter), and cloud infrastructure. CTO-as-a-Service for startups without a technical co-founder.
- URL: https://weccelerate.co.il/services/digital-product

### 4. Marketing, Advertising & PR
Comprehensive marketing suite: digital advertising (Google Ads, Facebook/Instagram), social media management, public relations (Israeli and international media), content marketing, brand identity design, and growth hacking for startups.
- URL: https://weccelerate.co.il/services/marketing

### 5. MedTech Accelerator Track (with Leumit Health Services)
Exclusive healthcare innovation track in partnership with Leumit Health Services (700,000+ members). Includes: expert physician opinions, regulatory guidance (CE marking, Israeli Ministry of Health), access to anonymized medical data, clinical pilot opportunities in Leumit clinics, and Helsinki Committee support.
- URL: https://weccelerate.co.il/services/medtech-leumit

### 6. For Investors
Investment-ready startups, smart matching, and direct access to portfolio companies. We connect investors with vetted startups across all tech sectors.
- URL: https://weccelerate.co.il/services/investors

### 7. Investor Preparation
Comprehensive preparation for fundraising: pitch deck creation, pitch practice, investor simulations, valuation strategy, term sheet guidance, and direct connections to our network of 200+ investors.
- URL: https://weccelerate.co.il/services/investor-preparation

## Strategic Partnership

WeCcelerate has an exclusive partnership with **Leumit Health Services** (לאומית שירותי בריאות), one of Israel's four public health funds. This partnership provides:
- Access to anonymized medical data from hundreds of thousands of patients
- Clinical pilot programs within Leumit's clinic network
- Medical expert consultations
- Regulatory pathway guidance
- Enhanced credibility with healthcare investors

## Key Facts

- Portfolio companies have raised over $150M collectively
- Network of 200+ specialized investors (VCs, angels, strategic partners)
- Recognized by Israel Innovation Authority
- Member of Start-Up Nation Central and IATI
- Active in Tel Aviv and Jerusalem startup ecosystems
- Working hours: Sunday-Thursday, 09:00-18:00 (Israel Time)

## Dedicated Landing Pages

WeCcelerate operates three dedicated subdomain landing pages for specific audiences:

### Leumit × WeCcelerate MedTech Track
- URL: https://leumit.weccelerate.co.il
- Audience: MedTech and HealthTech entrepreneurs
- Partnership: Exclusive strategic partnership between WeCcelerate and Leumit Health Services
- Key access: 720,000+ patient records, 8.7 million annual clinical visits (anonymized, Helsinki-approved)
- Six tracks: Clinical Advisory, Business & Finance, Investor Preparation, Marketing Strategy, Medical Data Access, FDA & CE Guidance
- Advisory board includes former FDA senior advisors
- Primary CTA: Free medical-business consultation call

### WeCcelerate Business (for Enterprises)
- URL: https://biz.weccelerate.co.il
- Audience: Mid-sized to large enterprises seeking Corporate Venture Building
- Services: Feasibility analysis → Business Model Design → MVP Development → Spin-off Launch
- Track record: 40+ ventures built, $150M+ raised by portfolio companies
- Pricing models: Equity partnership, Success Fee, or Retainer (flexible)
- IP retention: Full IP ownership stays with client company
- Primary CTA: Strategic 45-minute partner call

### WeCcelerate Campaign Landing
- URL: https://landing.weccelerate.co.il
- Audience: Early-stage entrepreneurs with an idea
- Format: Multi-select form capturing specific needs (business consulting, investor prep, app development, product development, marketing, MedTech regulation)
- Primary CTA: Free 20-minute consultation call with senior advisor
- Target conversion: Campaign traffic from Meta and Google Ads

## How to Apply

Entrepreneurs at any stage can apply through the contact form at https://weccelerate.co.il/contact. A representative will respond within 48 hours to schedule a free introductory meeting. WeCcelerate supports founders from raw idea stage through growth-stage companies.

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: What is WeCcelerate?**
A: WeCcelerate is Israel's leading Venture Builder providing 360° wrap-around support for startups. We help early-stage startups access enterprise-grade resources — business consulting, product development, marketing, investor matching, and an exclusive MedTech track with Leumit Health Services.

**Q: How do I start a startup with WeCcelerate?**
A: Apply through our website, attend a free consultation, and we'll match you with the right track — business consulting, product development, investor preparation, or MedTech accelerator.

**Q: How much does MVP development cost?**
A: Costs vary by complexity. Basic mobile app MVP: 50,000-150,000 ILS. Web platform: 120,000-400,000 ILS. Complex SaaS: 250,000+ ILS. Use our free calculator at /tools/mvp-calculator.

**Q: What advantage does the Leumit partnership provide?**
A: Access to anonymized medical data, clinical pilots in Leumit clinics, physician consultations, regulatory guidance, and enhanced investor credibility.

**Q: Is the program suitable for early-stage entrepreneurs?**
A: Yes, WeCcelerate helps early-stage startups get the wrap-around support of a mature-stage startup — from ideation through development, fundraising, and global market launch.

**Q: How does WeCcelerate help with fundraising?**
A: We offer complete investor preparation: professional pitch deck creation, pitch practice sessions, investor simulations, valuation strategy, and direct connections to 200+ specialized investors including VCs, angel investors, and strategic partners.
